rev: Certificate of Formation, Limited Liability Company (Revised 6.2025)
notes: Answers: the $180 filing fee box is always ticked; 'Yes' to expedite ticks the $100 box. A UBI or name reservation number ticks Yes and writes it; 'None' ticks No. Duration 'Years: 30' or 'Expires: date'; a later effective date is 'Specify: MM/DD/YYYY'. The registered agent is either a commercial agent (name only) or a non-commercial one (name, email, Washington street address); the other answers None. Addresses are 'street, city, ST ZIP' and go on each block's first line ('Same' ticks the same-as-street box). Executors are 'name; address; country; printed name and title' (up to two). Left for the signers: the agent's and each executor's signature and date. The form's first page of instructions is left as it is. Mailed with the fee to the Corporations and Charities Division, or the same filing made online in CCFS.
